description.summary: With a flourish, you can immediately end a maintained 1st level or higher song when a creature fails a Saving Throw, allowing the subject to immediately reroll the failed Saving Throw with a bonus equal to the level of the song you ended – 1 (ex: ending a 2nd level song gives a saving throw bonus of +1).
